ELEMENT_BOM.sql:
SELECT
  dqeb.material_no AS hf_part_no,
  dqeb.material_part_no AS "_物料与元素BOM_材质料号",
  dqeb.content_pct AS "_物料与元素BOM_组成含量（%）"
FROM ds_quote_element_bom dqeb
WHERE dqeb.material_no = ANY(:total_material_no)
ORDER BY dqeb.material_no, dqeb.material_part_no, dqeb.element_code, dqeb.item_seq

MATERIAL.sql:
SELECT
  dqm.material_no AS hf_part_no,
  dqm.material_no AS "_物料_销售料号",
  dqm.material_name AS "_物料_品名"
FROM ds_quote_material dqm
WHERE dqm.material_no = ANY(:total_material_no)
ORDER BY dqm.material_no

MATERIAL_BOM.sql:
SELECT
  dqmb.material_no AS hf_part_no,
  dqmb.input_material_no AS "_物料BOM_投入料号",
  dqmb.component_qty AS "_物料BOM_组成数量"
FROM ds_quote_material_bom dqmb
WHERE dqmb.material_no = ANY(:total_material_no)
ORDER BY dqmb.material_no, dqmb.input_material_no, dqmb.item_seq

SELF_PROCESS_FEE.sql:
SELECT
  dqspf.material_no AS hf_part_no,
  dqspf.input_material_no AS "_自制加工费_投入料号",
  dqspf.value AS "_自制加工费_值"
FROM ds_quote_self_process_fee dqspf
WHERE dqspf.material_no = ANY(:total_material_no)
ORDER BY dqspf.material_no, dqspf.input_material_no, dqspf.item_seq
